thesis: The episode argues that a new wave of innovation is emerging from a new web infrastructure stack, specifically WebRTC and WebGL, which enables low-latency, high-quality real-time collaboration for both enterprise applications and new social experiments. Additionally, the discussion posits that this technological shift may cause the predominant use case for virtual reality to move from dedicated headsets to the browser, while also noting that advancements in any medium expand its expressive range and create new design spaces for applications.
